title: The Coming Month's Statement and the Advance Amount — Independent Living Residency Agreement
content:
A resident of a continuing residency under the Independent Living Residency Agreement may pay in advance for the coming calendar month by one-time ACH payment, and the advance amount is set as follows.

## The amount

1. The coming month's statement is the monthly service fee in effect on the residency record plus, where the occupancy is double, the second person fee of the apartment type.
2. The advance amount is the coming month's statement, rounded to the cent half up.

## Fee in effect

The advance amount is not worked out until the residency record shows, as its fee in effect, the fee taking effect on the first day of the coming month under any annual increase whose notice period has already run.

Restated: the fee in effect read from the residency record for the coming month must already be the fee that takes effect on the first day of that month under an annual increase whose notice period has run; until the record shows it, there is no advance amount to work out.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Monthly service fee in effect | The residency record — the contracted monthly service fee and its rate effective date |
| Occupancy | The residency record — single or double |
| Second person fee | The figure of the apartment type, added only at double occupancy |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- Single occupancy, fee in effect 4,412.00: the coming month's statement is 4,412.00 and the advance amount is 4,412.00.
- Double occupancy, fee in effect 4,100.00 and a second person fee of 1,000.00: the coming month's statement is 4,100.00 plus 1,000.00, that is 5,100.00, and the advance amount is 5,100.00.
